## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
library(tidyverse) 
install.packages("tidytuesdayR")
wwbi_data <- tuesdata$wwbi_data
wwbi_series <- tuesdata$wwbi_series
wwbi_country <- tuesdata$wwbi_country


To further filter the data based on the "indicator_code" column and the "year" column, you can use additional filtering conditions in your code. Here's how you can modify the previous code to achieve this:

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
vnm_data <- wwbi_data %>% filter(grepl("VNM", country_code))
kable(vnm_data, "html") %>%
  kable_styling()

vnm_data <- wwbi_data %>%
  filter(grepl("VNM", country_code)) %>%
  filter(indicator_code == "BI.PWK.AGES.PB.SS.SM") %>%
select(year, value, indicator_code, country_code)
nm_data <- vnm_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 6)))

kable(vnm_data, "html") %>%
  kable_styling()

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(vnm_data, aes(x = year, y = value)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(year %in% c(2008, 2009, 2010), value, "")), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(title = "Vietnam's Mean age of public paid employees, by industry: Social Security",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Mean age") +

  theme_minimal()
